question: Can D02's item bound be raised so Pfizer's incorporated sub-note produces a result?
answer: Not by revising the MetricSpec alone. 64 is also a structural constant of the ORDERED_NEWLINE_V1 text-result protocol, hard-coded in text_results.render_text_payload, which every result of this kind passes through five times. A Spec may declare 192 and still be unable to produce 65 items.

layers.bound: a TEXT_V1 Spec may declare max_items <= 64
layers.frozen_by: execution authority of issue_28_v2 through v14 and issue_47_v1 - fourteen generations

layers.resolved_by: scripts/vnext/historical_spec_revision.py carries the raised ceiling as a rule file of this generation; specs.py keeps its bytes

layers.bound: render_text_payload refuses a payload of more than 64 items, whatever the Spec says
